metadata.title: The Lull of Blackwood
metadata.description: A quiet village has been frozen in time by a mysterious, rhythmic slumber. You are the first to wake, tasked with discovering the source of the curse before the silence claims the night.
metadata.author: PiperScenarioLab

act_1_discovery.name: The Awakening
act_1_discovery.description: You wake up in the silent courtyard and begin to assess the situation.

scene_1_courtyard.name: The Silent Courtyard
scene_1_courtyard.description: You open your eyes to a cobblestone yard. Cobwebs hang from every stone. Villagers stand motionless in their beds nearby.

scene_2_kitchen.name: The Empty Kitchen
scene_2_kitchen.description: You wander into the village kitchen. The table is set for dinner, but no one is there. A faint smell of rot lingers.

obj_1_examine_courtyard.description: Examine the courtyard for signs of disturbance.

act_2_investigation.name: The Forgotten Pact
act_2_investigation.description: You track down the source of the sleep, discovering an ancient altar and a mysterious NPC.

scene_3_altar.name: The Stone Altar
scene_3_altar.description: Deep in the woods, you find a circular stone altar covered in moss. A glowing flower sits in the center.

scene_4_basement.name: The Damp Basement
scene_4_basement.description: You descend into the old manor basement. A rusted key lies on a dusty table, and a faint hum vibrates through the floor.

obj_2_retrieve_key.description: Locate and retrieve the rusted key from the basement.

obj_3_identify_flower.description: Identify the cursed flower at the altar.

act_3_restoration.name: The Sacrifice
act_3_restoration.description: You perform the final ritual to restore the moonlight and wake the village.

scene_5_ritual_grounds.name: The Ritual Grounds
scene_5_ritual_grounds.description: You return to the altar with the key and flower. The sky above darkens as the moonlight begins to flow back into the world.

obj_3_perform_ritual.description: Combine the key and flower at the altar to break the curse.

act_3_restoration.ending_narration: As you place the key into the flower's base, the dark sky above shudders and breaks apart. Golden light pours down like rain, washing over the motionless figures. One by one, the villagers blink awake, stretching and smiling as the sun finally rises over the restored, living world.

npc_elder_mara.name: Elder Mara

motives: hide the truth of the pact

knows: where the stolen moonlight was taken

npc_silva.name: Silva
knows: the exact time the moon was stolen
can_reveal: the ritual to return the moon

item_cursed_flower.name: Cursed Moonflower
item_cursed_flower.description: A pale blue bloom that weeps silver tears. It was found near the shrine and seems to hum when held.

item_old_candle.name: Old Candle
item_old_candle.description: A tallow candle carved with runes that glow faintly in the dark. It burns without smoke.

item_dry_rations.name: Dry Rations
item_dry_rations.description: Hardtack and dried meat. Not much food, but enough to keep a traveler moving for a few days.

item_rusted_key.name: Rusted Key
item_rusted_key.description: A heavy iron key with no obvious lock, yet it feels warm to the touch.

skill_whisper_detect.name: Whisper Detect
skill_whisper_detect.description: Allows the user to hear faint sounds and words from creatures or objects that are otherwise silent.

skill_shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
skill_shadow_step.description: Lets the user move quietly through low light, leaving no footprints behind.

skill_pact_read.name: Pact Read
skill_pact_read.description: Reveals the hidden clauses and conditions of magical agreements or curses when touched.
